title: Dictator function as a singleton character
statement: For each coordinate $i \in [n]$, the dictator function on the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$ coincides with the Walsh--Fourier character associated to the singleton set $\{i\}$; that is, $\mathrm{dict}_i = \chi_{\{i\}}$ as functions $\{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$.
